fact: The ANSUT document 'Politique d'hébergement des données dans le cloud', version 1.0 dated 14 June 2021, was approved on 17 June 2021 by ANSUT's Directeur de l'Exploitation and sets the procedure for ministries and institutions to host applications in the cloud; no end or replacement is stated.
